feature.label: Eclipse Themes
feature.description:
Transform your coding experience with a fresh look for Eclipse. This feature provides a curated collection of popular color themes that beautify your syntax highlighting, including favorites like Solarized, Catppuccin, and GitHub Dark.
Style editors, views, tabs, toolbars, trees, and tables consistently, with an optional application-only GTK overlay for native Linux backgrounds and selections. Some operating-system and third-party controls may retain their native colors.
